answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce dynamic proof-of-work challenges. Requests pass through an admission prism that tunes puzzle difficulties before admitting identities into a settlement oasis. Agents must solve partial hash preimages, forcing an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of electrical energy and physical ferrous hardware per identity. However, this approach generates severe thermodynamic waste and privileges adversaries with specialized ASIC accelerators.
